what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the answer-questions-about-many-states folder: get a questions-first classifier ready on the person's Mac, start a bulk run of one question set over many states, read its status and paged answers, and cancel it.

payload.label: Get a questions-first classifier ready on this Mac
payload.job: Get my question classifier model ready to run on my Mac
payload.description: Fetches the weights a model row names (a pinned Hugging Face revision, or a local folder), checks they are a classifier family this tool runs (questions-first-decider: config.json, decider_config.json, the tokenizer and safetensors weights), and names them: the BLAKE3 identity of every file and of the whole set, to keep beside the model row. A gated model needs the person's own `huggingface-cli login`. Run it once per model row before start.

model.description: The model row from the person's list: which classifier family it is and where its weights are. No model is built in.

id.description: The row's own id, carried into the answers.

classifier.description: The classifier family: questions-first-decider is a Qwen3.5 hybrid decider whose questions are a cacheable prefix (decider.schema(questions).batch(states)).

weights.description: {"folder": a local folder} or {"hugging_face": {"repo", "revision"}} with a pinned revision.

get_it: python3 -m pip install -U mlx numpy tokenizers blake3 huggingface_hub
needs: mlx, numpy, tokenizers, blake3 and huggingface_hub
invoke.say: This runs on the person's own Mac, from the root of the Workshop checkout, with {input} the request as one JSON argument. The first run downloads the weights (about 4.5 GB for a 2B model).

provenance.source: This folder's MLX port of the Qwen3.5 hybrid backbone and of the decider's questions-first cache (Mapika/decider-2b, Apache-2.0, snapshot b37f7e1ba3fbc9238004cf531fabbee2619973fd); the Metal gated-delta scan from the decider lane's earlier MLX build. The model's own licence applies to its weights.

payload.label: Answer the same questions about many states, in bulk, on this Mac
payload.job: Ask the same set of questions about every one of these lines or records, all at once, with my classifier model
payload.description: Starts a bulk run in the background: every state (text, or JSON written compactly) is asked every question, with the questions run once as a cached prefix and the states batched against them on Apple's GPU through MLX. The answer for each state and question is the classifier's probabilities over its options (choice: each option; score: each level, with the expected level; noul: the probability of yes). The job id is the BLAKE3 identity of the whole request, so the same request names the same run and a finished one is not run again. Read it with tool:read-a-bulk-answer-run; stop it with tool:cancel-a-bulk-answer-run.

model.description: The model row from the person's list: which classifier family it is and where its weights are. No model is built in.

id.description: The row's own id, carried into the answers.

classifier.description: The classifier family: questions-first-decider is a Qwen3.5 hybrid decider whose questions are a cacheable prefix (decider.schema(questions).batch(states)).

weights.description: {"folder": a local folder} or {"hugging_face": {"repo", "revision"}} with a pinned revision.

questions.description: {question id: {type: choice|score|noul, instructions, criteria?}}: choice criteria name 2 to 255 options, score criteria are 2 to 10 ordered levels, noul criteria may describe true and false.

states.description: The states to ask about: strings, or JSON values (written compactly, long arrays numbered).

settings.description: The tool's settings, from the person's settings row; none has a default.

layout.description: independent: one row per question, so no question sees another (the decider's default); packed: every question in one prefix, one row per state, several times fewer tokens.

tokens_per_batch.description: How many tokens one GPU pass may hold.

max_state_tokens.description: The most tokens of a state the model reads; a longer state is cut there, as the decider does.

page_bytes.description: How many bytes of answers one read returns.

jobs_folder.description: The folder on the person's computer that holds runs while they work and until their answers are read.

get_it: python3 -m pip install -U mlx numpy tokenizers blake3 huggingface_hub
needs: mlx, numpy, tokenizers, blake3 and huggingface_hub

payload.label: Read how far a bulk answer run is, and its answers
payload.job: How far is my bulk question run, and give me its answers
payload.description: Says a run's status (queued, running, finished, cancelled or failed with why), how many states are answered and, once it is finished or cancelled, its answers as byte pages: {total, blake3, offset, length, base64, next_after_byte}. Ask again with after_byte set to next_after_byte until it is null, join the bytes, check the length and BLAKE3, and parse: {model, layout, questions, states, answers: [{state, answers: {question id: answer}}], seconds}. Keep what matters as rows in the person's lists; the run's folder is working space.

job_id.description: The job_id start answered: the BLAKE3 content identity of the whole request.
